summary: Great Basin Technical College wants a mechanical contractor, acting as prime contractor, to replace its campus central heating and cooling plant in Tanner Flat, Utah: two 400-ton chillers, cooling towers, three hot water boilers, pumps, controls, electrical service upgrades and temporary heating and cooling. The estimated construction cost is $4,200,000 to $4,800,000. Only prequalified bidders may bid; the prequalification statement is due March 12, 2027, a mandatory pre-bid meeting is on March 16, 2027, and bids are due Thursday, April 8, 2027 at 2:00 p.m.

notes.text: Only bidders the College has prequalified may bid, and the prequalification statement is due Friday, March 12, 2027. That is before the mandatory pre-bid meeting (March 16) and almost four weeks before bids are due (April 8). A contractor who first looks at this after March 12 cannot bid.

Your surety must confirm in a letter that you can be bonded for a single project of at least $5,000,000. That is more than the top of the estimated cost range ($4,800,000). The text does not say what else the prequalification statement must contain, where to send it, or a time of day for the deadline.

The text says the solicitation is open to all bidders, and also that only prequalified bidders may bid. I read 'open to all' as meaning there is no set-aside for any class of business, not that prequalification can be skipped.
The bid bond is given only as '5 percent'; the text does not say 5 percent of what. The text also does not say when the performance and payment bonds must be delivered.

The text names the Purchasing Office as the place bids are due but does not say whether bids are sealed, on paper or electronic. The questions deadline has a date but no time, and the text does not say where to send questions.
